bias.en: Turning bullish · steadied above the 10 and 30-day, under the 5-day
bias.zh: 转多 · 企稳于 10 日和 30 日均线上方，受制于 5 日均线

read.en: Rockwell rose 0.9% on Nov 2 to $440.16 (range $437.52–445.85) after a 3.4% drop on Oct 30. It is just below the rising 5-day ($442.15) and the falling 100-day ($446.06), and above the rising 10-day ($435.69), 30-day ($435.20) and 200-day ($427.16). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 27 and above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($418.96), and RSI is 54.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔 11月2日上涨 0.9%，收于 $440.16（区间 $437.52–445.85），此前 10月30日下跌 3.4%。股价略低于上行的 5 日均线（$442.15）和下行的 100 日均线（$446.06），位于上行的 10 日（$435.69）、30 日（$435.20）和 200 日均线（$427.16）上方。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$418.96），RSI 为 54。

read.en: No written level broke: the $432.8–435.7 support held and the bounce stalled just under $441.4. Resistance is $441.4–442.2 (Oct 21 high, 5-day), then $445.9–446.7 (Nov 2 high, 100-day, Oct 28 high) and $450.5–452.4. Support is $432.8–435.7 (10 and 30-day, Oct 30 low), then $427.2 (200-day, Oct 26 low) and $417.6–419 (Oct 22 low, SAR). A close above $446.7 would target $452; below $432.8, $427.
